difference-quotient.def: The average rate of change of $f$ between $x = a$ and $x = a + h$: $\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}$ for $h \ne 0$. Its limit as $h \to 0$ is the instantaneous rate of change at $a$.

secant-line.def: A line through two points of a graph. Its slope is the average rate of change of the function between those two inputs.
